meaning.en: even if I yearn (te-mo form of 焦がれる)
meaning.pt-BR: mesmo que eu ansie (forma -te-mo de 焦がれる)
meaning.es: aunque añore (forma -te-mo de 焦がれる)

translations.en: The sky is far, the clouds drift — even though I yearn from far, far, far away
translations.pt-BR: O céu é distante, as nuvens passam — mesmo ansiando de longe, longe, longe
translations.es: El cielo es lejano, las nubes pasan — aunque añore desde lejos, lejos, lejos

literal_meaning.en: sky + (topic) + far + cloud + (topic) + drift + far + far + far + to + yearn-even-if

meaning.en: shout; cry (compound of 叫び + 声)

meaning.es: grito; clamor (compuesto de 叫び + 声)

translations.en: Our shouts — Wow wow — will surely resonate only with the truth

translations.en: Set your heart ablaze — and then, let's join hands
